attchmntText: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Limited has published a newspaper advertisement on November 13, 2026, inviting the attention of shareholders regarding the transfer of equity shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund. The notice appeared in the English newspaper Mint across all editions and the Hindi newspaper Hindustan in the Delhi edition. The company has submitted copies of these notices to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India for their information and records.

attchmntText: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Release-  HCLTech featured among the top 50 global companies in Forbes World s Top Companies for Women 2026  '.
voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Limited has filed a press release with the BSE and NSE regarding its inclusion in the Forbes World’s Top Companies for Women 2026 list. The company is ranked among the top 50 global entities. It is the only India-headquartered firm in this ranking of over 400 companies. The assessment involved a survey of 140,000 women professionals. This marks the second consecutive year of this recognition. The company reports that women hold 50% of its board positions. It cites a 99.88% return-to-work rate for women employees taking parental leave in FY26. Consolidated revenues for the twelve months ending September 2026 totaled 14.8 billion US dollars. The filing serves for information and records.

attchmntText: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Release-  HCLTech and PTC collaborate to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management '.
voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Ltd. has announced a collaboration with PTC to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management. The partnership involves launching a pre-configured semiconductor Product Lifecycle Management solution built on the PTC Windchill platform. This solution aims to streamline product development, strengthen quality and compliance, and reduce operational complexity. It connects people, processes, and data across the semiconductor lifecycle, including IP management, new product introduction, supplier collaboration, and regulatory compliance. The solution integrates with existing business, manufacturing, and design systems for end-to-end visibility. HCLTech and PTC stated that the collaboration helps customers modernize product development and management at scale. The announcement was filed with the BSE and NSE on November 10, 2026.
